name: geo-site-diagnose
title: GEOHub 网站 GEO 诊断
job_to_be_done: Crawl one public website from a supplied URL, select up to ten representative page types, score evidence-lined GEO readiness, and generate a standalone visual HTML report. Use for 网站 GEO 诊断、全站 GEO 体检、网站 GEO 审计, or requests such as “帮我诊断网站GEO并附上网址”. Excludes single-page or brand-only diagnosis, live AI ranking or citation measurement, authenticated sites, and website modification.
